decision_rationale: The record describes a pre-trained RNA foundation model, but the selected full text identifies it as an encoder trained with masked language modeling and downstream prediction heads, not a generative architecture. Foundation-model evidence is present via large-scale pretraining on 28.1 million RNAs.
